description: This file contains the class definition for 'Smarty_Internal_Compile_Shared_Inheritance', which provides methods for handling inheritance compilation within the Smarty templating engine. It includes methods for initializing inheritance with post-compilation callbacks.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Shared_Inheritance
classes.description: Class that manages inheritance compilation processes, including initialization and registration of post-compile callbacks for shared inheritance features within Smarty templates.

methods.name: postCompile
methods.description: Static method to append PHP code that initializes inheritance, called after template compilation.

methods.name: registerInit
methods.description: Instance method to set up a callback for inheritance initialization after compilation, optionally forcing a child template sequence.
